title: feat(types)!: a list view's legacy options bag is the spec list overlay's bag by reference (objectui#6152, round 12)
body:
Part of #6152 (round 12)
Clause-②: no

This is the round's implementing PR. The seat answered the round's census (report `6070437445`) with Q1 → A, Q2 → B and Q3 → A on objectui#6152 (comment `6070475966`), under claim `6070030626`, and amended the file surface there. Whether the card closes after this round is the seat's call, so this body carries no closing keyword. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DBZ9bntPZ7VKyQNtJeNsgw`.

## What changes

**`@object-ui/types`, narrowed (breaking).** `@objectstack/spec`'s authoring list view declares no `options` bag. Its one home is the flattened list overlay on the view write door, judged there under objectui#10380's ruling A. `ListViewSchema.options` was a record of `any` with three named refusals, so every door accepted what that door refuses. It is now that member's own bag, by reference: `stripImportedDefaults(VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS.listOverlay.shape.options.unwrap())`, extended with this package's round-11 `kanban`, `calendar` (`.partial()`), `gallery` and `timeline` blocks. So the bag is strict, has the spec's eight kinds, each the list-view slot with every key optional, and keeps the spec's own error map, including the guidance for `options.grid`. Each named refusal gives one message under `options.KIND` and under the top-level `KIND`.

| written under `options` | now | write instead |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| a key that is not one of the eight kinds | `unrecognized_keys` at `options` | remove it |
| `grid` | `unrecognized_keys` at `options`, with the spec's guidance | the view's own top-level keys |
| any undeclared key in a kind (`kanban.swimlaneField`, `timeline.descriptionField`, `tree.titleField`, …) | the spec's `unrecognized_keys` at that kind | the kind's spec keys |
| `kanban.groupField` / `kanban.cardFields` | `invalid_type`, by name | `groupByField` / `columns` |
| `gallery.imageField` | `invalid_type`, by name | `coverField` |
| `timeline.dateField` | `invalid_type`, by name | `startDateField` |
| `calendar.defaultView` | `invalid_type`, by name | the `object-calendar` element's flat `defaultView` |
| `chart.xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` / `categoryField` / `valueField` / `aggregation` | the spec's `unrecognized_keys` at `chart` | `chart: { dataset, dimensions, values }` |
| a value of the wrong type | refused at its path | the declared type |

The three refusals already in place (`kanban.groupBy`, objectui#8365; `calendar.dateField` / `endField`, objectui#8355) keep their messages and now report `invalid_type`, where they reported `custom` while the bag was a record. The TypeScript face follows: `ListViewSchema['options']` has the eight kinds and no index signature.

**`@object-ui/types`, the two config types.** `ListViewTimelineConfig` is now the non-null `ListViewSchema['timeline']` (Q2 → B): the spec slot, strict and `.partial()`, with `dateField` refused by name. `ListViewGalleryConfig` is retired (Q3 → A); the remedy is the spec's `GalleryConfig`, which the package re-exports.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`, the producers (Q1 → A).** In `ObjectView.tsx`, `kanbanViewOptions` writes `columns` where it wrote `cardFields`; `timelineViewOptions` stops writing `descriptionField`; `galleryViewOptions` stops writing `imageField` beside `coverField`. Measured on the card before this round: the board's node and `$select` are identical under `columns`, and nothing drew the timeline's nested `descriptionField`. The legacy READS in these producers stay.

**`@object-ui/plugin-list`.** One capability-gate rung: `availableViews` also reads `options.gallery.coverField` (the objectui#8193 kanban precedent), so the coverField-only bag the relay now writes still offers the Gallery view. One more, compile-forced line in `ListView.tsx`, beyond the seat's "one rung": the grid branch's `options.grid` spread is typed at the read site as the stored input it is, because the typed bag no longer declares `grid`. It renders exactly as before. The README's two examples author the top-level per-kind blocks and a dataset-bound chart, and no longer show the bag.

**`@object-ui/plugin-timeline`.** `ObjectTimelineProps.schema.timeline` takes the new `ListViewTimelineConfig`; the prop's docs say what it is.

## What did not move

The renderers' reads: `ListView` still merges each `options.KIND` under the top-level block and still reads the legacy spellings (`groupField`, `cardFields`, `imageField`, `dateField`, the chart axes, `tree.titleField`, the `grid` spread), and `ObjectTimeline` still reads `timeline.dateField`. The render path parses nothing, so a row stored before these doors closed renders as before. `packages/plugin-view` is untouched (PR objectui#12010 holds it).

## Fixtures the narrowing flips, re-spelled with their tests

- `calendar-date-alias-refusal-8355.test.ts`: surface 2 now pins `invalid_type` and asserts the message equals surface 1's; its "nothing else is judged" scope control becomes an undeclared-key control.
- `kanban-stray-group-by-refusal-text-9653.test.ts`, `ListView.strayGroupByRefused-8365.test.tsx`: the bag channel's code is `invalid_type`.
- `list-view-dataset-chart-filter-refusal-10327.test.ts`: the object-bound bag control becomes a bag that binds no dataset (what it guards is unchanged).
- `object-chart-legacy-axis-keys-retired-10608.test.ts`: block (e) pinned the bag ACCEPTING the legacy axes; it now pins the refusal, with a dataset-bound control.
- `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`: the new crossing is measured. `VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS` is a record of schemas, not a schema, so it cannot be the direct argument of `stripImportedDefaults`. The census gains one enumerated category, `SCHEMA_RECORDS`, which accepts a read only when the whole member chain is that argument, and a test that each entry is a non-Zod record of schemas read only that way; `IMPORTED` gains the bag as a row.
- app-shell: `ObjectView.kanbanGroupByRetired-8213` (its residual set reaches zero), `galleryBinding-7547`, `kanbanLane-8193`, `kanbanSummarizeField-11629`.
- plugin-list `ListView.test.tsx`: two typed fixtures write `groupByField`.
- plugin-timeline `timeline-date-binding` and `ObjectTimeline.absentDateAxisRefusal-7459`: both keep the alias fixture (it models a stored block the reader must still bind), and each gains a real `@ts-expect-error` on a typed `ListViewTimelineConfig` carrying `dateField`.

## New pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/list-view-options-bag-6152.test.ts`: the installed overlay bag as a precondition (key set derived by the spec's own rule, each kind strict and fully optional); the mirror IS that bag (same keys, same error map, the round-11 blocks by identity); verdict equality with the spec's bag over 17 documents, plus the sanctioned default difference; every named refusal under `options.KIND` through all four doors with the top-level message; undeclared keys and kinds through all four doors; the TypeScript face, `ListViewTimelineConfig`, and the retired `ListViewGalleryConfig` import as a `@ts-expect-error`.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.galleryOptionsBagCanonical-6152.test.tsx`: the Gallery toggle both ways.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.optionsBagParses-6152.test.ts`: each exported producer's block parses at the bag's door, with a control that the door still refuses the three retired writes.

## Verification, on `372fa8f8f`

- Test union under the verify lock: `packages/types/`, `packages/plugin-list/`, `packages/plugin-timeline/`, `scripts/__tests__/`, app-shell's `ObjectView.*` and `InterfaceListPage.*` tests, and every test naming the bag's kinds or the two config types (80 extra files): `Test Files  790 passed | 2 skipped (792)`, `Tests  18251 passed | 39 skipped (18290)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Closure build (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'`, then the console): 39 of 39 tasks. Type-check, after it: `types`, `app-shell`, `core`, `i18n`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-tree`, `plugin-view`, `console`, `example-byo-backend-console`, each `Done`. plugin-timeline's test leg reads `@object-ui/types` through its rebuilt `dist`, and its two `@ts-expect-error`s compile only against the narrowed type, so a stale `.d.ts` would be red there.
- Ablations, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk anchor count and a restore checked against the HEAD blob: removing the new gate rung reds exactly the two coverField arms of the gallery pin (2 failed, 5 passed, as predicted); restoring the record bag reds 89 of the bag pin's 119 tests.
- Doc gates: `check:doc-snippets` (784 of 784 blocks, 0 failed), `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:docs-route-closure`, doc links, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`: green.
- Changeset gates: presence (one changeset for the 23 published source files of 4 packages), no-major, claims, pending-literals: green. The overwrite report lists `.changeset/6152-list-view-blocks-strict.md`: round 11's pending changeset said the bag was unchanged, and it carries an append-only dated note now, its text and frontmatter otherwise unchanged.
- `check:new-line-citations` 0 new, `check:control-bytes` OK, governed guard: NOT GOVERNED (26 paths).
- Targeted lint over the 21 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`eslint --no-inline-config`): one error, `no-restricted-imports` on `FormField` in `packages/types/src/index.ts`, identical at the base; nothing new. The repo-wide lint is CI's.

## Bundle

`check:eager-closure`, each tree built the same way under the lock: `origin/main` `7ebff3991` 3,391,414 B gzipped; this branch 3,391,315 B (`1a067c36a`; the one later commit changes test fixtures only). Delta −99 B, under the 3,391,484 B ceiling. The constant is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- The `options.grid` read-site typing in `ListView.tsx` is the one line beyond the seat's fence; without it `plugin-list` does not compile, and it changes nothing at runtime.
- `ListViewTimelineConfig` keeps its export name, now as the derived type, so `ObjectTimelineProps` keeps one consumer of it.
- Stored rows written before the view write door judged the bag (`@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0) keep rendering through the untouched readers; retiring those readers is the later, renderer-side round on objectui#6152.
